messages:
anya: Heads-up from morning UX check: pricing calculator area gets a ton of cursor dwell but virtually no CTA conversions. Heatmap link: https://redwood-internal/heatmaps/498765. Thinking a tiny in-module micro-modal to convert hover interest into a low-friction 'pricing workshop' signup.

ryan: Can you paste the numbers?

anya: calc module impressions 4.9k, calc CTA CTR 1.7%, hover->click ratio ~12:1, median hover 3.6s. Top FAQ (billing basics) expand 21%.

lexi: Hypothesis: users are curious about cost drivers but unsure which plan fits. Modal idea: 1-line value prop + 2-field form (email, company size) + option "send snapshot" vs "reserve workshop". We can A/B test which messaging routes to sales.

analytics-bot: Will need events: rw_calc_hover, rw_calc_modal_show, rw_calc_modal_submit, rw_calc_variant. Also capture calc_session_id and utm.

sales-ops: Routing suggestion: if modal_submit AND (company_size >= 250 OR utm contains "enterprise"), route to SDR "pricing-fast-track"; set 24h SLA. Else go to nurture. Tag leads with variant and calc_session_id.

ryan: I'll wire GTM events and add a short dashboard for funnel conversion and routing SLA compliance.

anya: Copy needed: two micro-variants. Variant A (workshop): "See Redwood costs at your scale 30-min workshop + live Q&A" CTA "Reserve a spot". Variant B (snapshot): "Get a quick cost snapshot for your workload" CTA "Get snapshot". Also micro-FAQ anchor: "What impacts cost most?" -> anchors to FAQ.

lexi: I'll draft modal copy and the two CTAs by EOD. Also propose showing modal only after second hover >2s to avoid noise.

analytics-bot: Deployed client badge with utm=pricing-nudge and will monitor events for 72h.

sales-ops: I'll create HubSpot workflow and add hidden calc_session_id. Question: do SDRs get variant context in the outreach template?

anya: Yes include variant token so SDR message can reference "pricing snapshot" vs "workshop". Also pre-fill email when logged-in.

ryan: Plan: 7-day A/B test, track modal_shown -> submit -> routed_to_sdr -> contact_time. Will report week-over-week.

anya: Action items: lexi copy variants + micro-FAQ link by EOD. ryan GTM events + dashboard by tomorrow. sales-ops HubSpot workflow + 24h SLA by tomorrow noon. analytics-bot confirm payload includes calc_session_id and auth_email when available.

lexi: On it. Will post copy in #marketing for quick review. :sparkles:
